Relative clauses where / when · 易错辨析: Relational adverbs introduce relative clauses: where = in which, when = on which.本课为易错辨析练习,核心:where modifies a place, when modifies a time, acting as an adverbial inside the clause。

where modifies a place antecedent: the school where I study|when modifies a time antecedent: the day when we met|where can be rewritten as prep + which|when can be rewritten as on/in which|why modifies the antecedent reason
